name: Emily "@astradotpng" Astranova
biography: Emily is a security consultant doing physical security testing, covert entry and penetration testing of all the things. Emily has intentionally compromised US power grid systems, unintentionally compromised data centers and has somehow managed to keep her record to only one run-in with the FBI. In her spare time, Emily volunteers as a software and cybersecurity mentor for high school students as a part of FIRST Robotics.
